title: zard/ui icon catalogue
description: The icon sets a registry supports and the table that translates between them, published at /r/icons.json. A client reads it at run time instead of relying on the copy it was built with, so a set added here works for CLIs that are already installed.

schemaVersion.description: The shape of this file. See registry.json for the rule on when it rises.

families.description: The supported sets, keyed by the value that goes in components.json.

icons.description: The translation table: one row per icon, keyed by what it means (check, chevron-down), and inside it the symbol each set exports for it. A row without an entry for a given set means that set has no equivalent — a client must leave the symbol alone and say so, rather than guess.

label.description: Display name, for prompts and reports.

package.description: The npm package the project needs, alongside @ng-icons/core.

prefix.description: The prefix the symbols of this package carry (lucide, for lucideCheck).
